Package com.hkust.marketplace.ui

Class Formats

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.ui.Formats
public final class Formats extends Object
One way to show dates, prices, ratings and periods on every screen, so all three portals look and read the same (non-functional requirement: a consistent interface).

  • Method Details

    • date

      public static String date(LocalDateTime time)
      "09 Nov 2026", or NONE for no date.

    • datePickerConverter

      public static javafx.util.StringConverter<LocalDate> datePickerConverter()
      How a date picker shows and reads its date: "21 Nov 2026", as date(java.time.LocalDateTime) shows dates in lists and tables, so a chosen date reads the same as the dates beside it (a consistent interface). Text typed into an editable picker is read in the same form, in any case; text that is not such a date, or no text, gives no date (null), which the form then reports. 
      
 DatePicker from = new DatePicker();
 from.setConverter(Formats.datePickerConverter());

    • dateTime

      public static String dateTime(LocalDateTime time)
      "09 Nov 2026 14:20", or NONE for no date: the time of a message, a notification or a posting. Times of borrowing use borrowTime(java.time.LocalDateTime) instead.

    • borrowTime

      public static String borrowTime(LocalDateTime time)
      A time of borrowing, to the second: "14 Nov 2026 14:06:44", or NONE for no time. Used for borrow periods and due dates, because borrowing works to the second; the due-date reminder names the due time in the same form (regression log R9).

    • timeOfDay
